name: Viking
notes: Built by Silo AI with TurkuNLP (University of Turku) and HPLT; released before the AMD acquisition.

name: Poro 2
notes: Built by AMD Silo AI with TurkuNLP.

name: Llama 4
notes: Llama 4 Community License: 700M-MAU clause, "Built with Llama" naming duty, AUP incorporated by reference. AUP withholds the licence for the multimodal Llama 4 models from individuals/companies domiciled in the EU (end users of products exempt). Data described only by category (public, licensed, Meta products incl. Instagram/Facebook posts). Released April 2025, before AI Act GPAI obligations (summary due 2027).

name: Gemma 4
notes: First Gemma generation under plain Apache 2.0 (earlier Gemma used the Gemma Terms of Use + Prohibited Use Policy). Card names data categories only (web, code, math, images, audio; cutoff Jan 2025). Pre-trained on TPUv4/TPUv6e. 35+ languages supported, 140+ in pre-training, no list given. AI Act summary seen only via AIAL tracker; primary URL not located.

name: gpt-oss
notes: Apache 2.0 plus a one-sentence USAGE_POLICY file (comply with applicable law). Text-only pre-training data "with a focus on STEM, coding, and general knowledge", cutoff June 2024. 2.1M H100-hours for 120b. AIAL lists gpt-oss among models whose mandatory AI Act summary could not be found.

name: Phi-4-Reasoning-Vision
notes: MIT. SFT of Phi-4-Reasoning (itself from Phi-4) with Google SigLIP-2 vision encoder (mid-fusion). 240 B200 for 4 days; Phi-4 base pre-trained on 1920 H100. DATACARD.md is the EU AI Act public summary (Microsoft Ireland). Primarily English; not intended for multilingual use.

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3
notes: NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License (Dec 2025): Apache-like, perpetual/irrevocable, but adds licensee indemnity for outputs and US export-compliance clause. Pre-trained 25T tokens (NVFP4); most pre-/post-training datasets released on HF (code/math/multilingual gated); some third-party/vendor sets private. Long-context phase on GB200. Heavy use of Qwen/DeepSeek/gpt-oss synthetic data.

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5
notes: Licence switched to OpenMDW-1.1 (Linux Foundation, MIT-style permissive model licence) for Nemotron 3.5 Lightning. Pre-trained >20T tokens with NVFP4 recipe. Datasets largely released; purchased vendor data (Mercor, Turing, TAUS, Patronus) private. Post-training also used closed models (GPT-5.5, Gemini 3/GPT-5 prompts, Claude 4 Sonnet filtering). Origin per NVIDIA AI Act summary ("developed from NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B"); the card only says pre-trained on >20T tokens. Source to add.

name: Granite 4.2
notes: Apache 2.0. Post-trained (SFT + GRPO RL with NeMo RL/Gym) from Granite 4.1 base (from scratch, ~15T tokens, CommonCrawl ~59%). Machine-readable dataset disclosures (AIBOM JSON) on GitHub; many post-training sets are NVIDIA Nemotron datasets. Trained on NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 at CoreWeave (location not stated). AIAL lists Granite 4.2 AI Act summary as missing.

name: Olmo 3 / 3.1 Instruct
notes: Apache 2.0; Responsible Use Guidelines referenced as intent, not licence condition. Dolma 3 (pre/mid/long-context) and Dolci (post-training) released with code (OLMo-core, Open Instruct) and intermediate checkpoints. 1024 H100 cluster. Synthetic data from GPT-4.1, o4-mini, QwQ-32B, DeepSeek R1, Qwen3.

name: Qwen3.8 (Apache-2.0 open models)
notes: Card states Pre-training & Post-training and "built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5"; whether initialised from a Qwen3.5 checkpoint is not stated. No technical report or data section for Qwen3.8; the 2.4T-A95B flagship sits under a separate Qwen3.8-Max License.

name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
notes: Qwen Community License 1.0: commercial use by any Model-as-a-Service or AI-coding/office-assistant business needs a separate licence from Qwen (no revenue threshold); name display above 100M MAU or USD 20M monthly revenue. Tech report covers architecture and ablations, not the data mix. Experimental preview of the Qwen4 architecture.

name: DeepSeek-V4 (Pro)
notes: Pre-trained on more than 32T tokens; AI Act public summary covers DeepSeek-V4 (Pro and Flash): Common Crawl, Stack Exchange, licensed data, own synthetic data, no user data. Tech report validates inference on NVIDIA GPUs and Huawei Ascend NPUs but does not name the pre-training hardware.

name: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
notes: Trained from scratch on a 45T-token multimodal corpus (7:1 text to multimodal; Common Crawl re-bootstrapped). Final on-policy distillation uses over 40 teacher models that are not named. The AI Act summary found covers V4 only.

name: Kimi K3
notes: Native multimodal 2.8T MoE trained jointly on text and vision from the start; pre-training data spans web text, code, mathematics and knowledge, with rephrased knowledge and math corpora (rephrasing model not named). Kimi K3 License: MaaS operators above USD 20M yearly revenue need a separate agreement; name display above 100M MAU or USD 20M monthly revenue.

name: GLM-5.3
notes: Same base model as GLM-5.2; gains come from post-training only. GLM-5.3 License replaces the MIT licence of GLM-5.2: MaaS operators above USD 10B yearly revenue must pass a Z.ai security review whose scope Z.ai determines. Post-training data and teachers not documented.

name: GLM-5.3-Flash
notes: Newly trained base model (hybrid sparse and linear attention, mHC) on a 30T-token multimodal pre-training corpus; mix not described. Plain MIT licence.

name: MiniMax-M3
notes: Mixed-modality training from the first step. AI Act public summary: over 10T text tokens, over 1B images, over 1M video hours; Common Crawl, licensed and private third-party data, own synthetic data. MiniMax Community License: non-commercial by default; commercial use needs "Built with MiniMax M3" attribution and a notice, prior written authorisation above USD 20M yearly revenue; prohibited uses include any military purpose.

name: Tencent Hy4 preview
notes: 770B-A49B MoE (Gated DeepSeek Sparse Attention, IndexCache, iHC). Plain Apache-2.0, without the territory exclusions of earlier Hunyuan community licences. Post-training data built with Tencent in-house experts; pre-training data not described. Card ships fine-tuning scripts, not pre-training code. An AI Act summary exists for Hy3 only.

name: K-EXAONE 2.0
notes: Upcycled from K-EXAONE (48->78 layers, 128->256 experts), then continual pre-training, mid-training and post-training. GPUs provided by a Korean government programme; location and accelerator not stated. First EXAONE under Apache-2.0.

name: EXAONE 4.5
notes: Vision-language model: 1.2B vision encoder trained from scratch, attached to EXAONE 4.0 32B. EXAONE AI Model License 1.2 - NC prohibits commercial use and lets the licensor amend it at any time.

name: Solar Open 2
base_model: Solar Open 1 (selective weight transfer, 2.3% of weights)
notes: 250B-A15B hybrid linear-attention MoE, ~12T tokens. Initialised by selective transfer of 2.3% of Solar Open 100B weights, rest random (own lineage). Upstage Solar License = Apache-2.0 plus mandatory 'Solar' name prefix and 'Built with Solar'. Korean MSIT/NIPA GPU track, clusters by Lablup; location not stated.

name: HyperCLOVA X SEED Think
notes: Language backbone pre-trained by NAVER (6T tokens in stage 1); vision encoder taken from Qwen2.5-VL, which the press says included its trained weights. Custom licence: commercial use allowed, extra terms above 10M MAU, binding AUP, NAVER may amend at any time.

name: LLM-jp-4.1 thinking
notes: Pre-training and mid-training 11.7T tokens; most of the corpus is published (some parts withheld for licensing reasons); SFT/DPO data published. SFT responses were regenerated with gpt-oss-120b. Trained on ABCI 3.0 (AIST, Japan).

name: Qwen3-Swallow v0.2
notes: CPT on 209.7B tokens (Japanese, English, math, code), then SFT and RLVR. Trained on ABCI 3.0 and TSUBAME4.0 (Japan). A technical paper was announced but not checked here.

name: GPT-OSS-Swallow v0.1
notes: CPT on 419.4B tokens, then SFT (gpt-oss-120b generated responses) and RLVR. Trained on ABCI 3.0 and TSUBAME4.0 (Japan).

name: PLaMo 3 NICT (2604)
notes: Base model only (not instruction-tuned); the instruct flagship PLaMo 3.0 Prime is closed-weight. The 31B was distilled from PFN/NICT's 120B (3T tokens), which is not released; the card does not say whether by pruning or logit distillation. Gated PLaMo Community License: commercial use only with registration and annual revenue <= JPY 1bn; PFN may amend.

name: Sarvam 30B / 105B
notes: MoE models trained from scratch (30B: 16T tokens, 105B: 12T tokens). Training entirely in India on IndiaAI Mission compute; GPU type not stated, NVIDIA contributed libraries. Hub metadata lists 'bo' (Tibetan), probably meant for Bodo.

name: Nemotron-SEA-LION v4.8
notes: CPT of 33.5B tokens (English + 10 SEA languages) on H200 in Singapore, then SFT and on-policy distillation from Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B. AISG releases it under MIT, but the upstream base is under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License; how the two interact was not checked. Licence caveat: the base is under the NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License; how it binds the MIT release is unchecked.

name: Qwen-SEA-LION v4.5
notes: Post-training only (logit distillation from Qwen3.5-397B-A17B on SEA-Instruct-2602, plus model merging). Vision-language.

name: Falcon-H1
notes: Hybrid attention/Mamba2. TII Falcon License: Apache-2.0-based with modifications and an Acceptable Use Policy that 'may be updated from time to time'. Synthetic rewrites by unnamed 'internal and external open models'.

name: Falcon-H1R
notes: Reasoning model: cold-start SFT on long reasoning traces plus GRPO RL on Falcon-H1-7B-Base. Report discusses teacher models for traces but does not name them.

name: K2-Horizon
notes: Released by MBZUAI's Institute of Foundation Models (IFM). Pretraining 15T tokens in two phases, then midtraining to 512K, RL experts merged, SFT. Data, xLLM training code, logs and intermediate checkpoints published. A Math-Reasoning subset is named 'math-thinking-qwen' but no teacher model is named explicitly. Tech report was still 'In Progress'.

name: Jamba2
notes: SSM-Transformer (Mamba) hybrid. Mid-training on 500B tokens, SFT, DPO, on-policy RL starting from Jamba 1.5 pre-training (also stated for the 3B dense model). AI21 announced in May 2026 it would halt Jamba development. Languages are the pretraining emphasis of the Jamba 1.5 base; Jamba2 itself names none.

name: Command A+
notes: Sparse MoE, 218B total / 25B active, text+image input. Cohere's first MoE model; the AI Act summary lists >10T text tokens and synthetic data from Command A and other internal models. Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face; Cohere's Usage Policy applies to Cohere-hosted deployments.

name: Tiny Aya
notes: 3.35B, pretrained on 6T tokens (public and proprietary sources, 70 languages) on 256 H100s; region-specialised variants (global, earth, fire, water). CC-BY-NC plus Cohere Labs Acceptable Use Policy; gated on the Hub.
